C1815.title: Ecovacs Robot Vacuum BLE Hijack Speech Incident
C1815.summary: From May to October 2024, multiple Ecovacs Deebot X2 units in Minnesota, Los Angeles, and El Paso were remotely hijacked. Attackers exploited PIN-only-app-verification and device-shared static key flaws to get cloud tokens and remotely take over, playing racial slurs and profanity via the speaker, chasing pets, and accessing live cameras. DEF CON 32 had earlier disclosed Ecovacs Bluetooth flaws (130 m takeover, reading Wi-Fi passwords and home maps). Ecovacs denied a breach, attributing it to credential stuffing.
